name: Websites - Authorized - Global Domains [is]
description: Intent: Authorized global corporate domains — populate with sanctioned corporate websites and SaaS not covered by channel-specific lists (e.g., acme.com intranet, support.acme.com, marketing.acme.com, acquired-co-wiki.com). Drives the Authorized split on W1000 / B1000 (general Web governance catch-all). Lower priority — populate during W1000 / B1000 rollout to avoid blanket warns/blocks on corporate sites. Exclusions: do not add external partner sites unless they are corporate-owned; do not add untrusted public sites; channel-specific Authorized lists (cloud, GenAI, etc.) take precedence and should be populated first.
